implementation: Profile/User/Catalog/Question business handlers implemented; remaining 9 callables are guarded and unimplemented
schemaReference: For callable X, use #/$defs/XRequest and #/$defs/XResponse in schemas
requires: Firebase Auth token, admin === true and active accountAccess checked by server

mapping.questionVersion: Admin integer 1 corresponds to RTDB currentVersion v1; immutable questionVersions/id/v1 and questionAnswers/id/v1
mapping.options: Four stable IDs beginning with a letter or underscore; array maps to RTDB keyed options {optionId:{text,order:1..4}}
mapping.contentPublication: Draft/archived ancestors gate new session selection; descendant statuses and existing snapshots are retained
mapping.questionArchive: Archive creates a new integer version as well; stale saves cannot republish using the previous expectedVersion
mapping.listening: TTS audioText only; audioUrl must be empty; file uploads are deferred
mapping.ongoingBattle: Public admin status ongoing maps from authoritative playing/reconnecting states; do not expose pending opponent answers
mapping.privateContent: Admin question/answer payloads are returned only by authorized API, not public catalog reads
mapping.pagination: Page numbers require bounded server snapshots/indexes; response page includes snapshotId, expiresAt, nextCursor; do not download the root
mapping.editRevision: Profile/User/Content responses carry revision; edits and status changes require expectedRevision. Question edits require expectedVersion
mapping.notificationsReadAll: Provide exactly one of id or throughAt; throughAt is the fixed read-all cutoff, retained over retries
mapping.export: requestId is required, query contains filters only, no page/pageSize/cursor/snapshotId; never silently truncate
mapping.operationResponse: All mutations and exports include operationId; successful replay returns the original stored envelope

errors.unauthenticated: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked token; sign in again
errors.permission-denied: Claim is not boolean true in token/current Auth, account disabled or access not active
errors.invalid-argument: Schema, cross-field validation or bounds failed
errors.already-exists: request-id-conflict, or a business uniqueness conflict
errors.failed-precondition: version-conflict, admin-self-protection, operation-result-expired or blocked operation requiring server review
errors.resource-exhausted: Rate or report bounds exceeded; retryAfterMs when applicable
errors.aborted: Operation pending, target busy or lease lost; retry the SAME requestId and payload
errors.unavailable: Temporary service failure; preserve input and requestId
errors.unimplemented: Business handler is not available in the current implementation
errors.internal: Response contract failed; no source record or server exception is returned
